alt: Multi-source breadth-first search on a warehouse floor. Every depot (D) starts in the queue at distance 0. Each cell that leaves the front of the queue passes its distance plus one to its open, unseen neighbors, which join the back. A cell no depot's search can reach, because walls cut it off, never gets a distance.
